items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: "So he says, 'I would really like for you to bring a band in here.' ... So I says, 'Okay.'"

ctx.x: Sol Moore, I don't know what happened to Sol, a hell of an arranger. He had good arrangements and a good band. They'd been there seven years, but they were all alcoholics. Never could get them all on the stand. Every one of them was just -- I mean, terrible alcoholics. So he put up with that for many years. So he says, "I would really like for you to bring a band in here." He says, "I'm going to give them another chance, but, I'm not going to keep giving them chances. Now, you think about that." So I says,…
